line: Crowley's Two of Wands is the card for the first decan of Aries, with Mars as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: Crowley's chapter gives the title and the planet in Aries.

quotes.quote: The Two of Wands is called the Lord of Dominion
The background of this card shows the power of the planet Mars in his own sign Aries,

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: This card, pertaining to Chokmah in the suit of Fire, represents the Will in its most exalted form.

sections.title: The decans before the cards
sections.line: Neither Jung nor Burt gives a decan system in the sources held here. The passages below are von Franz on the older decanate images. They are not a basis for the Crowley card.

quotes.quote: Bruno arranges the thirty-six images of the decanates, the forty-nine planetary images (seven per planet), and finally the thirty-six representations said to pertain to the circle of the twelve zodiac signs, into a circular system.
The complete structure, however, is not meant to represent a horoscope,
representations of the decanates in the Egyptian posthumous journey to heaven) were illustrated in the tombs.
